title: Rycar Ryjerd
caption: Rycar Ryjerd (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. If your character is about to be lost from table, place all devices and Effects on that character in owner’s Used Pile. Twice per game, may ▲ a device (or an Effect) that deploys on a character. {alter}
lore: A Bimm trader and *smuggler* of starship weapons. Trusts no one. Does business with anyone. Teaches smuggler apprentices. Has mastered Jawa language.
